subject: general
question: Which of the following ensures genetic variation in sexually reproducing animals?

options.text: Offspring receive genes from both parents

solution: The correct answer is __**Offspring receive genes from both parents**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • ** is ensured in sexually reproducing animals as offspring inherit genes from both parents**, resulting in unique genetic combinations. • During **sexual reproduction**, the fusion of male and female gametes (sperm and egg) combines genetic material from both parents, leading to diversity. • This process of genetic mixing is facilitated by **meiosis**, which creates gametes with half the genetic material of the parent and ensures recombination of genetic traits. • The genetic variation helps species adapt to changing environments and provides a survival advantage by introducing new traits into the population. • Other factors like **mutations**, genetic recombination during meiosis, and random fertilization further contribute to the diversity of offspring.
